the molecular mechanisms by which the contractile function of airway smooth muscle cells (ASM) is regulated in health and disease.
the molecular mechanisms underlying the heightened contractility of airway smooth muscle cells (SMC) in asthma.

the molecular basis for heightened airway smooth muscle contractility, a key component of the pathophysiology of asthma, which is a disease that is characterized by increased airway responsiveness to bronchoconstrictive stimuli.
